title: Prove every conversation is registered and that the owner's resource limits really hold
why: Usage, conversations and limits are only real if a run shows them. This replays real model-backed chats, a voice-surface turn, agent tasks and direct, group and self conversations, then checks the registry, the minute, hour and day usage, the ranges, the natural-language and UI controls, pause, throttle, terminate and emergency stop at the gate, persistence across a reload, export and overhead, on desktop and iPhone. It needs the dev server on 5173 (or LELU_BASE) and a free provider key (Groq, OpenRouter or Cerebras). It spends only free-tier calls.

steps.title: Run the WP13/WP19 acceptance
steps.why: Writes docs/missions/usage-monitor/verify-usage.json and shots/. A check that could not run because every provider was offline is reported UNVERIFIED, never passed.

steps.title: Look at the monitor and an agent's workspace
steps.why: Check that the transcripts are real model text, that refused calls say why, and that nothing in the monitor claims a number its source did not report.
